videos.title: 골드만삭스가 던진 코스피 12000…보수적 전망이라는 진짜 이유
videos.subtitle_summary:
The user wants a summary of a YouTube video transcript in Korean, around 500 characters, with 3-5 sentences. The video is about Goldman Sachs predicting KOSPI 12,000 and calling it "conservative."
Key points from the transcript:
1. Goldman Sachs predicted KOSPI 12,000, calling it conservative
2. Main drivers: Foreign capital inflow, semiconductor supercycle (HBM leadership by Samsung/SK Hynix), Value-up policy (corporate governance improvements), favorable exchange rates
3. OECD raised Korea's growth forecast from 1.7% to 2.6%
4. Korea being recognized as AI ecosystem hub (Nvidia considering AI tech center)
5. Risks remain (global rates, US big tech earnings, China recovery)
6. Most important: World's view on Korean stock market is changing
I need to write this in Korean only, no English, around 500 characters, 3-5 sentences.
